caption:
Stillness is not running away from life.
It is returning to yourself.
So many people live with noise in their mind, tension in their body, and heaviness in their heart and think it’s normal.
It’s not. It’s a nervous system asking for rest.
Yang Mun teaches that healing doesn’t come from forcing change,
but from creating safety within.
If you feel tired for no clear reason,
if your mind never truly rests, if peace feels unfamiliar - this message is for you.
The path back to stillness is simple, but it must be practiced.
That’s why the 30 Day Healing
Journey exists.
